title: 'Secrecy discipline' is key in hunting down Bato dela Rosa, says Lacson

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Panfilo Lacson reminded authorities on Sunday to be cautious in publicizing information about their next move in hunting down Sen. Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, warning that it could compromise their operations. “SSSHHH… : When pursuing a high-profile target or handling a sensitive live case, secrecy discipline is key, unless disinformation is necessary to flush the quarry into the open,” Lacson said in a post on X. The PNP intensified its manhunt for Dela Rosa, days after the one-week surrender ultimatum given by PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. lapsed last Friday.
